evals.prompt: Stream a chat completion from gpt-4o-mini and print tokens as they arrive.
evals.expected_output: `new OpenAI({ baseURL: 'https://api.openai.com/v1', apiKey })`, `await openai.chat.completions({ ..., stream: true })`, for await reading `event.data.choices[0]?.delta?.content`.

evals.prompt: Point the client at our OpenAI-compatible gateway and add an X-Trace-Id header to every request.
evals.expected_output: Sets baseURL including /v1; adds `openai.fetcher.interceptors.request.use({ name, order, intercept })` (order required) mutating headers; notes only Bearer auth is sent.

evals.prompt: How do I show the HTTP status when the completion request fails, and not swallow stream errors?
evals.expected_output: Catches HttpStatusValidationError/ExchangeError and reads `error.exchange.response?.status`; rethrows SyntaxError or network errors raised during iteration.
